import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "score": [95.5, 87.3, 92.1]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory (bytes buffer)
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the binary data
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nParquet binary size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from binary buffer
buffer.seek(0)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
print("\nRound trip successful:", df.equals(df_restored))

```python
import polars as pl
from io import BytesIO

# Create a sample DataFrame
df = pl.DataFrame({
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"],
    "age": [25, 30, 35],
    "score": [95.5, 87.3, 92.1]
})

print("Original DataFrame:")
print(df)

# Serialize to Parquet in memory (bytes buffer)
buffer = BytesIO()
df.write_parquet(buffer)

# Get the binary data
parquet_bytes = buffer.getvalue()
print(f"\nParquet binary size: {len(parquet_bytes)} bytes")

# Read back from binary buffer
buffer.seek(0)
df_restored = pl.read_parquet(buffer)

print("\nRestored DataFrame:")
print(df_restored)

# Verify round trip
print("\nRound trip successful:", df.equals(df_restored))
```
